s.t: A woman lived alone in a small home.
s.fr: Une femme vivait seule dans une petite maison.

s.t: The woman wanted to have a little child.
s.fr: La femme voulait avoir un petit enfant.

s.t: One day, she went to see an old witch.
s.fr: Un jour, elle alla voir une vieille sorcière.

s.t: "Please give me a child," the woman said.
s.fr: « Donnez-moi un enfant, je vous en prie », dit la femme.

paras.summary: A woman lives alone and wants a child, so she goes to an old witch and asks for one.

s.t: The witch listened and gave her a small seed.
s.fr: La sorcière écouta et lui donna une petite graine.

s.t: "Put this seed in a pot by the window," said the witch.
s.fr: « Mettez cette graine dans un pot près de la fenêtre », dit la sorcière.

s.t: "A flower will grow from this seed," she said.
s.fr: « Une fleur poussera de cette graine », dit-elle.

s.t: The woman thanked the witch and went home.
s.fr: La femme remercia la sorcière et rentra chez elle.

paras.summary: The witch gives her a small seed, tells her to put it in a pot by her window, and says a flower will grow from it; the woman thanks her and goes home.

s.t: She put the seed in a pot by the window.
s.fr: Elle mit la graine dans un pot près de la fenêtre.

s.t: She gave it water every morning and every night.
s.fr: Elle lui donnait de l’eau chaque matin et chaque soir.

s.t: Soon a green plant grew, and a large bud sat on it.
s.fr: Bientôt une plante verte poussa, et un grand bourgeon s’posa dessus.

s.t: The woman looked at the dark red bud every day.
s.fr: La femme regardait le bourgeon rouge foncé chaque jour.

paras.summary: She plants the seed by the window and waters it until a green plant grows a large, dark red bud, which she looks at every day.

s.t: One morning, the red bud opened in the warm sun.
s.fr: Un matin, le bourgeon rouge s’ouvrit dans le soleil chaud.

s.t: In the flower sat a tiny girl.
s.fr: Dans la fleur était assise une toute petite fille.

s.t: She was as small as the woman's thumb.
s.fr: Elle était aussi petite que le pouce de la femme.

s.t: "My pretty girl!" said the woman.
s.fr: « Ma jolie fille ! » dit-elle.

s.t: The woman named her Thumbelina.
s.fr: La femme la nomma Thumbelina.

paras.summary: One morning the bud opens in the sun, and in the flower sits a tiny girl as small as a thumb; the delighted woman names her Thumbelina.

s.t: She made Thumbelina a little bed from a walnut shell.
s.fr: Elle lui fit un petit lit à partir d’une coquille de noix.

s.t: Thumbelina slept in the shell by the window.
s.fr: Thumbelina dormait dans la coquille près de la fenêtre.

s.t: Soft petals covered her at night.
s.fr: De doux pétales la couvraient la nuit.

s.t: Every morning, Thumbelina sang in the sun by the window.
s.fr: Chaque matin, Thumbelina chantait au soleil près de la fenêtre.

paras.summary: The woman makes her a bed from a walnut shell by the window, covers her with soft petals at night, and Thumbelina sings every morning.

s.t: On warm nights, the woman left the window open.
s.fr: Les nuits chaudes, la femme laissait la fenêtre ouverte.

s.t: Thumbelina looked at the dark sky from her shell.
s.fr: Thumbelina regarda le ciel sombre depuis sa coquille.

paras.summary: The woman loves to hear her sing and leaves the window open on warm nights, and Thumbelina looks at the night sky from her shell, the woman happy with her tiny girl.

s.t: One night, an old toad came in at the open window.
s.fr: Une nuit, un vieux crapaud entra par la fenêtre ouverte.

s.t: The old toad looked at the pretty girl.
s.fr: Le vieux crapaud regarda la jolie fille.

s.t: The toad wanted a wife for her son.
s.fr: Le crapaud voulait une femme pour son fils.

s.t: She took the walnut shell with Thumbelina in it.
s.fr: Elle prit la coquille de noix avec Thumbelina dedans.

paras.summary: One night an old toad comes in at the open window, sees the pretty girl asleep, and takes her shell away because she wants a wife for her son.

s.t: The toad hopped away into the dark night.
s.fr: Le crapaud sauta dans la nuit sombre.

s.t: The old toad carried her away to a stream.
s.fr: Le vieux crapaud l’emporta jusqu’à un ruisseau.

s.t: She put the shell on a lily pad in the water.
s.fr: Elle posa la coquille sur un nénuphar dans l’eau.

s.t: In the morning, Thumbelina woke up on the lily pad.
s.fr: Le matin, Thumbelina se réveilla sur le nénuphar.

paras.summary: The toad hops off into the dark, and Thumbelina sleeps on as she is carried to a stream and set on a lily pad, where she wakes in the morning.

s.t: Water was all around the lily pad.
s.fr: L’eau était tout autour du nénuphar.

s.t: Thumbelina could not get back to the land.
s.fr: Thumbelina ne pouvait pas retourner sur la terre.

s.t: The old toad came back with her son.
s.fr: Le vieux crapaud revint avec son fils.

s.t: "Croak, croak," was all the son could say.
s.fr: « Coâ, coâ » était tout ce que le fils pouvait dire.

s.t: "You will live with my son in the mud," said the toad.
s.fr: « Tu vivras avec mon fils dans la boue, » dit le crapaud.

paras.summary: Water is all around, and Thumbelina cannot get back to land; the toad returns with her croaking son and says Thumbelina will live with him in the mud.

s.t: The toads hopped away to make a home in the mud.
s.fr: Les crapauds sautèrent pour faire un nid dans la boue.

s.t: She began to cry in the morning sun.
s.fr: Elle commença à pleurer sous le soleil du matin.

s.t: She did not want to live in the mud with the son.
s.fr: Elle ne voulait pas vivre dans la boue avec le fils.

paras.summary: The toads hop off to make a home in the mud, and Thumbelina sits alone on the lily pad and cries, not wanting to live there with the son.

s.t: Little fish swam in the stream by the lily pad.
s.fr: De petits poissons nageaient dans le ruisseau près du nénuphar.

s.t: The fish heard Thumbelina cry all day.
s.fr: Les poissons entendirent Thumbelina pleurer toute la journée.

s.t: "She should not live with the ugly toad," said one fish.
s.fr: « Elle ne devrait pas vivre avec le vilain crapaud, » dit un poisson.

paras.summary: Little fish hear her cry all day, look up at her, and decide she should not have to live with the ugly toad.

s.t: The little fish began to bite the green stem of the pad.
s.fr: Le petit poisson commença à mordre la tige verte du nénuphar.

s.t: They bit the stem again and again.
s.fr: Ils mordirent la tige encore et encore.

s.t: Soon the stem broke free from the mud.
s.fr: Bientôt la tige se détacha de la boue.

s.t: The lily pad floated away down the stream.
s.fr: Le nénuphar flotta au loin sur le ruisseau.

s.t: Thumbelina thanked the little fish and smiled.
s.fr: Thumbelina remercia les petits poissons et sourit.

paras.summary: The fish bite through the stem until it breaks free, and the lily pad floats down the stream, carrying Thumbelina away from the toad; she thanks the fish and smiles.

s.t: Thumbelina floated on the lily pad for a long time.
s.fr: Thumbelina flotta sur le nénuphar pendant un long moment.

s.t: The sun went down, and night came to the water.
s.fr: Le soleil se coucha, et la nuit vint sur l’eau.

s.t: In the morning, a beetle saw her from a tall tree.
s.fr: Le matin, un scarabée la vit depuis un grand arbre.

s.t: He flew down to the lily pad.
s.fr: Il vola jusqu’au nénuphar.

s.t: The beetle took Thumbelina up into the tall tree.
s.fr: Le scarabée emporta Thumbelina en haut dans le grand arbre.

paras.summary: Thumbelina floats on for a long time, through a night, and in the morning a beetle sees her from a tall tree, flies down, and carries her up into the tree.

s.t: The beetle thought Thumbelina was pretty.
s.fr: Le scarabée pensait que Thumbelina était jolie.

s.t: Other beetles came to look at the tiny girl.
s.fr: D’autres scarabées vinrent regarder la petite fille.

s.t: "She has only two legs," said one beetle.
s.fr: « Elle n’a que deux jambes, » dit un scarabée.

s.t: "She has no feelers," said the other beetles.
s.fr: « Elle n’a pas d’antennes, » dirent les autres scarabées.

s.t: "She is not pretty at all," they all said.
s.fr: « Elle n’est pas jolie du tout, » dirent-ils tous.

paras.summary: The beetle thinks she is pretty, but the other beetles come to look and say she has only two legs, no feelers, and is not pretty at all.

s.t: He did not want Thumbelina now.
s.fr: Il ne voulait plus Thumbelina maintenant.

s.t: The beetle flew down and put her on a daisy.
s.fr: Le scarabée descendit et la posa sur une marguerite.

s.t: He flew away and left her all alone.
s.fr: Il s’envola et la laissa toute seule.

paras.summary: The beetle listens to them and does not want her now, so he flies her down, puts her on a daisy, and leaves her all alone.

s.t: All summer, Thumbelina lived alone in the green woods.
s.fr: Tout l’été, Thumbelina vécut seule dans les bois verts.

s.t: She made a small bed of petals under the daisy.
s.fr: Elle fit un petit lit de pétales sous la marguerite.

s.t: She lived on the water from the flowers every day.
s.fr: Elle vivait de l’eau des fleurs chaque jour.

s.t: A swallow sang in a tree over her.
s.fr: Une hirondelle chanta dans un arbre au-dessus d’elle.

s.t: Thumbelina loved to hear the swallow sing every day.
s.fr: Thumbelina aimait entendre l’hirondelle chanter chaque jour.

s.t: She was happy, but she thought of the woman at home.
s.fr: Elle était heureuse, mais elle pensait à la femme à la maison.

paras.summary: All summer Thumbelina lives alone in the green woods, sleeping in a bed of petals under the daisy, living on water from the flowers, and listening to a swallow sing over her, happy but thinking of the woman at home.

s.t: Soon the days turned cold in the woods.
s.fr: Bientôt les jours devinrent froids dans les bois.

s.t: The leaves turned yellow and fell to the ground.
s.fr: Les feuilles devinrent jaunes et tombèrent à terre.

s.t: Snow began to fall from the dark sky.
s.fr: La neige commença à tomber du ciel sombre.

s.t: The snow covered the ground and all the flowers.
s.fr: La neige couvrit le sol et toutes les fleurs.

paras.summary: The days turn cold, the leaves turn yellow and fall, and snow covers the ground and the flowers.

s.t: Thumbelina was cold, and she had no warm home now.
s.fr: Thumbelina avait froid, et elle n’avait plus de maison chaude maintenant.

s.t: She could not keep her small bed warm in the snow.
s.fr: Elle ne pouvait pas garder son petit lit chaud dans la neige.

s.t: She looked for a warm home under the ground.
s.fr: Elle chercha une maison chaude sous la terre.

s.t: At last, she came to a little hole in the ground.
s.fr: Enfin, elle arriva à un petit trou dans le sol.

paras.summary: Cold and with no warm home, Thumbelina cannot keep warm in the snow, so she looks for a home under the ground and at last comes to a little hole.

s.t: A field mouse lived in the warm hole under the ground.
s.fr: Un mulot vivait dans le trou chaud sous la terre.

s.t: "Please give me a little food," said Thumbelina.
s.fr: « Donnez-moi-moi s’il vous plaît un peu de nourriture », dit Thumbelina.

s.t: "I have had no food for two days."
s.fr: « Je n’ai pas mangé depuis deux jours. »

s.t: "Come in and get warm," said the kind field mouse.
s.fr: « Entrez et réchauffez-vous », dit le gentil mulot.

paras.summary: A field mouse lives in the warm hole, and when Thumbelina begs for food after two days with none, the kind mouse asks her in to get warm.

s.t: The field mouse gave her food and a warm bed.
s.fr: Le mulot lui donna de la nourriture et un lit chaud.

s.t: "You may stay here with me for the winter," said the mouse.
s.fr: « Vous pouvez rester ici avec moi pour l’hiver », dit le mulot.

s.t: "But you must keep my home and sing for me."
s.fr: « Mais vous devez entretenir ma maison et chanter pour moi. »

s.t: Thumbelina thanked the kind field mouse.
s.fr: Thumbelina remercia le gentil mulot.

paras.summary: The mouse gives her food and a warm bed and says she may stay the winter if she keeps the home and sings for her, and Thumbelina thanks her.

s.t: She kept the little home warm all winter.
s.fr: Elle garda la petite maison chaude tout l’hiver.

s.t: Every morning, Thumbelina sang for the field mouse.
s.fr: Chaque matin, Thumbelina chantait pour le mulot.

s.t: Thumbelina thought of the sun and the flowers.
s.fr: Thumbelina pensait au soleil et aux fleurs.

paras.summary: Thumbelina keeps the home warm and sings every morning, and the mouse loves to hear her; the hole is warm while the snow is cold, but Thumbelina thinks of the sun and the flowers.

s.t: The field mouse had a rich neighbor, an old mole.
s.fr: La souris des champs avait un riche voisin, une vieille taupe.

s.t: The mole lived under the ground and did not love the sun.
s.fr: La taupe vivait sous la terre et n’aimait pas le soleil.

s.t: One day, the mole came to see the mouse.
s.fr: Un jour, la taupe vint rendre visite à la souris.

s.t: "Sing for my neighbor," said the field mouse.
s.fr: « Chante pour mon voisin, » dit la souris des champs.

s.t: Thumbelina sang for the mole in her soft voice.
s.fr: Thumbelina chanta pour la taupe de sa voix douce.

s.t: The mole loved her voice and wanted Thumbelina for his wife.
s.fr: La taupe aimait sa voix et voulait Thumbelina pour sa femme.

s.t: "You should marry the rich mole," the mouse said.
s.fr: « Tu devrais épouser la riche taupe, » dit la souris.

paras.summary: The mouse has a rich old neighbor, a mole who lives under the ground and does not love the sun; when he visits, Thumbelina sings for him, and he loves her voice and wants her for his wife, so the mouse says she should marry him.

s.t: The mole made a long tunnel under the ground.
s.fr: La taupe creusa un long tunnel sous la terre.

s.t: One day, he took Thumbelina into the dark tunnel.
s.fr: Un jour, il emmena Thumbelina dans le sombre tunnel.

s.t: A bird was down on the ground in the tunnel.
s.fr: Un oiseau était tombé par terre dans le tunnel.

s.t: It was a swallow, cold and still.
s.fr: C’était une hirondelle, froide et immobile.

paras.summary: The mole takes Thumbelina into his long, dark tunnel, where a swallow lies on the ground, cold and still.

s.t: "I do not love birds," said the mole.
s.fr: « Je n’aime pas les oiseaux, » dit la taupe.

s.t: He went on into the dark.
s.fr: Il s’enfonça dans l’obscurité.

s.t: But Thumbelina thought of the swallow that sang in the summer.
s.fr: Mais Thumbelina pensa à l’hirondelle qui chantait en été.

paras.summary: The mole says he does not love birds and goes on, but Thumbelina thinks of the swallow that sang in the summer and looks back at the still bird.

s.t: At night, Thumbelina went back to the tunnel all alone.
s.fr: La nuit, Thumbelina retourna seule au tunnel.

s.t: She covered the cold swallow with hay.
s.fr: Elle couvrit l’hirondelle froide de foin.

s.t: Thumbelina felt the swallow, and it was a little warm.
s.fr: Thumbelina toucha l’hirondelle, et elle était un peu chaude.

s.t: The swallow was not dead at all.
s.fr: L’hirondelle n’était pas morte du tout.

s.t: All that winter, Thumbelina took hay and water to the swallow.
s.fr: Tout cet hiver, Thumbelina apporta du foin et de l’eau à l’hirondelle.

s.t: She kept the swallow a secret from the mole.
s.fr: Elle cacha l’hirondelle à la taupe.

s.t: Soon the swallow was strong again.
s.fr: Bientôt l’hirondelle fut de nouveau forte.

paras.summary: At night Thumbelina returns to the tunnel alone, covers the cold swallow with hay, and feels that it is a little warm — not dead; all winter she takes it hay and water in secret from the mole, and soon it is strong again.

s.t: Warm winds came, and spring came back to the fields.
s.fr: Des vents chauds vinrent, et le printemps revint dans les champs.

s.t: The swallow could fly again in the spring.
s.fr: L’hirondelle pouvait voler de nouveau au printemps.

s.t: "Thank you for the hay and the water," said the swallow.
s.fr: « Merci pour le foin et l’eau, » dit l’hirondelle.

s.t: "Come away with me to a warm land," he said.
s.fr: « Viens avec moi dans un pays chaud, » dit-il.

paras.summary: When warm winds come and spring returns, the swallow can fly again; he thanks Thumbelina for the hay and the water and asks her to come away with him to a warm land.

s.t: Thumbelina wanted to go away and see that warm land.
s.fr: Thumbelina voulait partir et voir ce pays chaud.

s.t: But she thought of the kind field mouse and her warm home.
s.fr: Mais elle pensa à la gentille souris des champs et à sa maison chaleureuse.

s.t: "I will not leave her now," Thumbelina said to the swallow.
s.fr: « Je ne la quitterai pas maintenant, » dit Thumbelina à l’hirondelle.

s.t: The swallow flew away all alone into the spring sky.
s.fr: L’hirondelle s’envola seule dans le ciel du printemps.

paras.summary: Thumbelina wants to see that land, but she thinks of the kind field mouse and will not leave her now, so the swallow flies away alone into the spring sky.

s.t: Soon the field mouse wanted a wedding for the fall.
s.fr: Bientôt la souris des champs voulut un mariage pour l’automne.

s.t: "You will marry the mole in the fall," said the mouse.
s.fr: « Tu épouseras la taupe en automne, » dit la souris.

s.t: The days turned cold, and the leaves turned yellow again.
s.fr: Les jours devinrent froids, et les feuilles redevinrent jaunes.

s.t: The wedding day came at last.
s.fr: Le jour du mariage arriva enfin.

s.t: The field mouse made Thumbelina a wedding dress.
s.fr: La souris des champs fit à Thumbelina une robe de mariée.

paras.summary: The field mouse wants a fall wedding for Thumbelina and the mole, and when the days turn cold and the leaves turn yellow again, the wedding day comes and the mouse makes Thumbelina a wedding dress.

s.t: "You will live with the mole under the ground," said the mouse.
s.fr: « Vous vivrez avec la taupe sous la terre, » dit la souris.

s.t: But Thumbelina did not want to live down under the ground.
s.fr: Mais Thumbelina ne voulait pas vivre sous la terre.

s.t: "Could I go out and see the sun one last time?"
s.fr: « Pourrais-je sortir et voir le soleil une dernière fois ? »

s.t: The field mouse said yes.
s.fr: La souris des champs dit oui.

paras.summary: The mouse says Thumbelina will live with the mole under the ground, but Thumbelina does not want that life and asks to go out and see the sun one last time; the mouse says yes.

s.t: Thumbelina went out and looked up at the warm sun.
s.fr: Thumbelina sortit et leva les yeux vers le soleil chaud.

s.t: She heard the swallow, and he flew down to her.
s.fr: Elle entendit l’hirondelle, et il descendit vers elle.

s.t: "I will marry the mole," she said to the swallow.
s.fr: « Je vais épouser la taupe, » dit-elle à l’hirondelle.

s.t: "Come away with me to the warm land," said the swallow.
s.fr: « Viens avec moi vers la terre chaude, » dit l’hirondelle.

s.t: Then she got on the swallow's back, and they flew away.
s.fr: Puis elle monta sur le dos de l’hirondelle, et ils s’envolèrent.

paras.summary: Outside in the sun she hears the swallow, who flies down to her; she tells him she is to marry the mole, he asks her again to come to the warm land, and after one last thought of the kind mouse, she gets on his back and they fly away.

s.t: The swallow flew on with Thumbelina over woods and cold water.
s.fr: L’hirondelle continua à voler avec Thumbelina au-dessus des bois et de l’eau froide.

s.t: At last, they came to a warm land of flowers.
s.fr: Enfin, ils arrivèrent dans un pays chaud de fleurs.

s.t: The swallow put Thumbelina on a large flower.
s.fr: L’hirondelle posa Thumbelina sur une grande fleur.

s.t: In the large flower sat a tiny man.
s.fr: Dans la grande fleur était assis un petit homme.

s.t: He was as small as Thumbelina, and he looked at her.
s.fr: Il était aussi petit que Thumbelina, et il la regarda.

paras.summary: The swallow flies Thumbelina over woods and cold water to a warm land of flowers and puts her on a large flower, where a tiny man as small as her sits.

s.t: The man had white wings on his back.
s.fr: L’homme avait des ailes blanches sur son dos.

s.t: He had a small crown.
s.fr: Il avait une petite couronne.

s.t: He was the prince of all the flowers.
s.fr: Il était le prince de toutes les fleurs.

s.t: In every flower lived a tiny man or a tiny woman.
s.fr: Dans chaque fleur vivait un petit homme ou une petite femme.

s.t: The prince looked at Thumbelina and smiled.
s.fr: Le prince regarda Thumbelina et sourit.

s.t: "Will you stay here and be my wife?" asked the prince.
s.fr: « Voulez-vous rester ici et être ma femme ? » demanda le prince.

s.t: Thumbelina looked at the little prince and said yes.
s.fr: Thumbelina regarda le petit prince et dit oui.

paras.summary: The man, with white wings and a crown, is the prince of all the flowers, and tiny people live in every flower; he smiles at Thumbelina and asks her to be his wife, and she says yes.

s.t: The tiny men and women all came out of the flowers.
s.fr: Les petits hommes et femmes sortirent tous des fleurs.

s.t: They came to the wedding of Thumbelina and the little prince.
s.fr: Ils vinrent au mariage de Thumbelina et du petit prince.

s.t: One tiny woman put white wings on Thumbelina's back.
s.fr: Une petite femme posa des ailes blanches sur le dos de Thumbelina.

s.t: Thumbelina could now fly from flower to flower.
s.fr: Thumbelina pouvait maintenant voler de fleur en fleur.

s.t: She flew over the warm land of flowers with the prince.
s.fr: Elle vola sur la terre chaude des fleurs avec le prince.

s.t: The tiny men and women sang for the wedding all night.
s.fr: Les petits hommes et femmes chantèrent pour le mariage toute la nuit.

paras.summary: The tiny men and women come out of the flowers for the wedding, one of them puts white wings on Thumbelina's back so she can fly over the land with the prince, and they all sing for the wedding all night.

s.t: The swallow watched the wedding from his tree by the flowers.
s.fr: L’hirondelle regarda le mariage depuis son arbre près des fleurs.

s.t: He sang one last song for Thumbelina.
s.fr: Il chanta une dernière chanson pour Thumbelina.

s.t: The swallow flew away to his home over the cold water.
s.fr: L’hirondelle s’envola vers sa maison au-dessus de l’eau froide.

s.t: Thumbelina watched him go from her flower.
s.fr: Thumbelina le regarda partir depuis sa fleur.

s.t: She lived with the prince as queen of the flowers.
s.fr: Elle vécut avec le prince comme reine des fleurs.

s.t: The little girl from the flower was home at last.
s.fr: La petite fille née de la fleur était enfin chez elle.

paras.summary: The swallow watches from his tree and sings one last song, then flies away to his home over the cold water; Thumbelina watches him go, then lives with the prince as queen of the flowers, sleeping in a white flower at night, home at last.
